notes: PERK ANIMATIONS REBUILT: real hands with fingers and a thumb, and smooth motion. BOWL: a glass pipe in one hand and a lighter in the other - the flame bends into the bowl, it glows as you pull, then a big rolling exhale (and sometimes a cough). JOINT: pinched between your fingers with smoke trailing off the tip, the cherry flares with sparks, then the exhale and an ash flick. EDIBLE: a gummy bear, head first, in three bites while you chew. When it kicks in, a coloured haze and a gentle wobble.
